card.name: Small words before a tool or surface
card.fires_on: Small linking words (a, with, onto, on, the) in step-by-step instructions, right before the tool or surface used in a hands-on action. Examples are a fingernail, scissors, a hard surface or the canvas.

modes.label: Tool phrase
modes.description: A or with just before the tool used for a physical step.
modes.example: Using<< a>> fingernail, the woman should peel

modes.label: Surface phrase
modes.description: On or onto just before the surface where something is placed or dropped.
modes.example: If you drop the prefilled syringe<< onto>> a hard surface, do not use it

modes.label: Other
modes.description: A rarer case is the middle of a long chemical name.

card.writes: It adds little that is clear; it slightly suppresses paper and cardboard words, so the next word is more likely a tool or surface.
card.plain: It fires on the small word before the tool or surface in how-to steps, such as peel with a fingernail or drop onto a hard surface.
